description: This file defines MIDI related constants and static utility methods following the MIDI 1.0 standard. It includes byte values for various MIDI message types, message length arrays, and methods for determining message length and activity sensing within MIDI messages.

classes.name: MidiConstants
classes.description: A class containing MIDI protocol constants and static methods for MIDI message processing.

methods.name: getBytesPerMessage
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes in a MIDI message based on the status byte.

methods.name: isAllActiveSensing
methods.description: Checks if all bytes in a message are 'Active Sensing' messages.
